samples.question: Earlier I saw someone pushing a blue cart down the beach; when I saw that same cart again later, what were people doing around it?
samples.answer: They were setting up a surfboard and beach gear next to the cart near the shoreline.
samples.mcq_options: A. They were loading the cart with driftwood and seaweed they had gathered along the shoreline. B. They were setting up a surfboard and beach gear next to the cart near the shoreline. C. They were using the cart as a makeshift bench while watching people near the rocky jetty. D. They were unpacking a tripod and camera gear from the cart to photograph the cloudy beach.

samples.answer: A fruitcake and a coffee cup.
